definition: Diella (Albanian pronunciation: [djɛɫa], from diell 'sun') is an artificial intelligence system developed by the National Agency for Information Society of Albania (AKSHI).
details: Introduced in January 2025 as a virtual assistant integrated into the eAlbania platform, it assists citizens with online public services and issuing digital documents. In September 2025, following a presidential decree authorizing Prime Minister Edi Rama to oversee the creation of a virtual AI minister, Diella was formally appointed as "Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence" of Albania in the fourth Rama government, making it the first AI system in the world to be named in a cabinet-level government role.

explainer.lead: Diella is an AI assistant built into Albania’s eAlbania platform to help citizens use online public services and obtain digital documents. It gained wider significance in September 2025, when it was appointed Albania’s Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence, becoming the first AI system named to a cabinet-level government role.

tiers.eli5: Diella is like a digital helper at a government service desk, except the desk is on the eAlbania website. It helps people find their way through online services and get digital documents. In 2025, Albania also gave this helper the formal title of Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence.
tiers.practitioner: Diella is applied at the platform level as a virtual assistant within eAlbania, supporting citizen interactions with public-service and digital-document workflows. Its ministerial title should not be treated as evidence about its technical architecture, autonomy, or authority to make government decisions.
tiers.paperLevel: Diella is an AI system developed by Albania’s National Agency for Information Society (AKSHI), introduced in January 2025 as an eAlbania virtual assistant for online public services and digital-document issuance. Its September 2025 appointment as Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence is an institutional designation rather than a formal model specification.

explainer.example: A citizen who needs a digital document through eAlbania can use Diella for assistance with the online process rather than navigating the public-service request entirely alone.

explainer.intuition: The basic idea is to place an AI assistant between citizens and government online services, helping people complete tasks without navigating every service unaided. Diella extends that idea from a platform assistant to an AI system formally named in a cabinet-level role.
howItWorks: A citizen uses the eAlbania platform for an online public service.
Diella acts as the platform’s virtual assistant.
It helps the citizen with the service or the process of issuing a digital document.
Its separate ministerial title places the system in Albania’s cabinet-level artificial-intelligence portfolio.
explainer.whyItMatters: Diella connects a practical citizen-service assistant with an unusually prominent government appointment. Its September 2025 cabinet role made Albania the first country to name an AI system to such a position.
misconceptions: Diella is an AI system, not a human minister.
It did not begin as a minister: it was introduced as an eAlbania assistant in January 2025 and received the cabinet appointment that September.
The ministerial title does not itself describe a new AI model or establish that Diella governs autonomously.
